name: GST Invoices
author: udkwp

sections.description:
A minimal, dependency‑free PDF invoice generator for WooCommerce with Indian GST helpers.

Highlights (Lite)
– Email attachments: attach invoice PDF to Completed/Processing emails.
– My Account downloads: “Download Invoice” button for order owners.
– Company details: name, GSTIN, address printed on invoice.
– HSN/SAC + GST split: reads product HSN/SAC meta; shows IGST/CGST/SGST split per line using order tax data.
– No external PDF libraries (tiny built‑in generator).

Multilingual
If Polylang or WPML is active, company details entered in settings are registered as strings so you can translate them per language.

Usage

Admin (generate/view)

  • Go to WooCommerce → Orders → click GST Invoice icon in Actions column, or open an order and click the same action.

Customers (My Account)

  • Customers will see Download Invoice on their Orders list and the single Order details page (must be logged in and own the order).

Email attachments

  • The plugin attaches the invoice on Completed and Processing emails by default.
    Use this filter to change which emails attach:
    add_filter( ‘udkwp_gstin_attach_on_emails’, function(){ return array( ‘customer_completed_order’ ); } );

HSN/SAC & GST split

  • Add HSN/SAC to products via a custom field _hsn_sac (or _hsn).
  • The invoice reads line‑item taxes and prints IGST/CGST/SGST with percent and amount based on WooCommerce tax items.
sections.installation:
1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Upload and activate GST Invoices.
  3. Go to Settings → GST Invoices and fill Company Name, GSTIN, Address, and Invoice Prefix (default: INV-).
sections.faq:
I don’t see the action or My Account button

Check WooCommerce is active and the user has permissions (admin/shop manager). My Account link requires the user to be logged in and to own the order.

Can I translate company details?

Yes, with Polylang or WPML active, settings values are registered for translation under the domain GST Invoices (Polylang) or gst-invoices (WPML).
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: Attach PDF to Woo emails (Processing/Completed) with filter to customize emails.
  • New: “Download Invoice” button in My Account (orders list + order details).
  • New: Company details (name, GSTIN, address) printed on invoice.
  • New: HSN/SAC per product (from _hsn_sac/_hsn) and line‑level GST split (IGST/CGST/SGST).
  • New: Polylang/WPML string registration for company details.

1.0.6

  • Expanded Installation/Usage/FAQ for reviewers and users.

1.0.5

  • Translators comments for placeholder strings in i18n to satisfy WPCS.

1.0.4

  • Removed discouraged load_plugin_textdomain().

1.0.3

  • Hardening: capability checks on settings & order actions; enqueue only on order screens.
